datasheet_identity.title: MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOD-323 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: The MM3Z9V1 row gives VZ min/nom/max = 8.5/9.1/9.6 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT maximum 15 ohm at IZT; ZZK maximum 160 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA; IR maximum 0.2 microA at VR = 7.0 V. The typical temperature coefficient is 3.8 to 7.0 mV/degC at IZTC = 5 mA (p. 2).

The p. 3 zener-characteristic traces are unlabeled and cannot be attributed to MM3Z9V1 without guessing. The Ta = 25 degC forward trace in Fig. 3 was digitized as a family-typical curve and converted from mA to A; it is not part-specific.
No per-part capacitance or reverse-recovery time is published; the p. 4 capacitance plot is family-level and was not assigned to this part.
